name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP ration cuts: Gaza, Sudan, Chad
summary: WFP halved Gaza rations from October and is cutting aid in Sudan and Chad; caseload cuts, not a full suspension
state: WFP said on 19 Oct that funding shortfalls forced it to halve food rations in Gaza and cut its monthly reach from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people, having received less than half its usual funding for 2026 (WFP; Reuters via TimesLIVE). In September UN agencies warned that Sudan's aid networks risked collapse as funds fell (Al Jazeera, 14 Sep). Searches on 15 Nov found no formal large-scale suspension of food or health aid in a famine-risk country, so Watch is kept.
for_you: Ration cuts fall hardest on displaced families and children in Gaza, Sudan and Chad. UK government aid statements and UN agency appeals describe where funding is short.
rubric_hit: Watch: major ration cuts announced (WFP halved Gaza rations, 19 Oct); no pipeline break forcing large-scale suspension

sources.title: WFP — Funding cuts force WFP to drastically reduce lifesaving assistance in Gaza
TimesLIVE (Reuters) — World Food Programme cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza
Al Jazeera — Sudan aid networks at risk of collapse, UN agencies warn

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
